provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready low, wide decorative floor prop for a side-view 2D exploration platformer; one PNG sprite-like asset
Primary request: Create exactly one connected scatter of collapsed catacomb offerings: exactly two broken ceramic urns, a few flat stone fragments, one short length of loose chain, and a restrained handful of small bones, all integrated into one cohesive low debris silhouette.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with clean alpha; completely isolated prop; no depicted environment.
Subject: Two visibly broken, partially collapsed ceramic urns nested into the rubble, accompanied by only the specified stone fragments, chain, and small bones. Make the pieces overlap or touch enough to read as one connected prop, while retaining generous internal gaps and an asymmetrical spread.
Style/medium: authentic production 16-bit pixel art; chunky deliberate pixel clusters; crisp hard pixel edges; limited palette; no smoothing and no antialiasing.
Composition/framing: exact 3:1 landscape composition representing three 32-pixel tiles wide by one tile tall. Center the complete uncropped subject. Spread it asymmetrically across most of the three-tile width. Keep every visible piece grounded to a common bottom anchor and mostly within the lower half of the canvas. Strong, very low silhouette; highest point strictly below the canvas midpoint, corresponding to below half the height of a two-tile-tall player. Decorative only, with irregular low spacing and no collider-like solid block.
Color palette: dark navy and indigo shadows, muted blue-purple ceramics and stones, sparse pale-blue highlights only on the small bones; readable against a dark Catacombs environment.
Materials/textures: cracked ceramic shards with sparse pixel highlights; flat worn stone chips; simple dark metal chain links; tiny restrained bone splinters.
Constraints: exactly one connected debris prop; exactly two broken urns; a few flat stones; one short loose chain; only a restrained handful of small bones; complete subject visible; transparent negative space around the silhouette; crisp native pixel-art appearance.
Avoid: tall pedestals, upright full-height columns, intact urns, intact sarcophagi, coffins, large skulls, characters, creatures, scenery, walls, arches, floor or ground plane, cast shadow, atmospheric effects, text, UI, border, frame, watermark, extra objects outside the scatter, photorealism, painterly texture, blur, gradients, smoothing, antialiasing, cropping.
